nodes.question: Which group had the highest average score in Using behaviour, and what was the corresponding score?
nodes.answer: Waste Warriors had the highest average score of 4.64 in Using behaviour compared to Waste Conscious (4.10), Waste Moderate (3.84), and Waste Laggards (3.12).
